records.source_text:
# Combined baseline review

Reviewed submitted evidence for integration `6b3da9f7`, including frontend
correction 2 (`0dcb783d`). Claude session 1 reports running the unchanged Codex
harness in a disposable checkout with isolated data and loopback access. Codex
copied all seven evidence files byte-identically and inspected all six PNGs.
Original report status remains unchanged; this document records the separate
review. Evidence and source hashes are in
`evidence/v4-integration/combined-submitted-20261022/`.

## Decision

The 15-check combined foundation harness gate is satisfied for this submitted
baseline, with Codex rendered inspection. This is accepted submitted execution
evidence, not a claim that Codex independently ran a browser in its restricted
sandbox. It is not full product/release acceptance or approval of the unmerged
Proposa adoption `427420eb`.

## Rendered inspection

- `01-denied`: explicit 401 and denied project list; no fabricated connection.
- `02-proposa-grid`: selected persisted Proposa record, actual project source,
  revision, and workspace navigation; test goal states isolated fixture.
- `03-execution-verified`: three succeeded tasks and one receipt; execution
  verified and human review pending appear separately, with frozen input and
  artifact/receipt references. Assignment controls fit.
- `04-registered-worker`: the deterministic worker is local and the chief is
  unconfigured; no implied provider connection.
- `05-narrow-grid`: all four destinations remain visible; inspector and actions
  fit. Map labels are small at this zoom, so the selected-record inspector remains
  important. The selected design's list projection is still future frontend work.
- `06-narrow-reduced-motion`: visible navigation, project and recorded session;
  no folding panes obscure content. Motion removal itself is a harness assertion,
  not something a still screenshot alone proves.

The report records 15 passing assertions, including real assignment/verification,
portfolio-position restoration, actual child-server restart persistence,
401/422 rejection, corruption rejection, accepted-context staleness, narrow
overflow and reduced-motion checks, and no browser errors.

## Remaining work

Session 1 must first correct the four findings in `V4_PROPOSA_REVIEW.md`, with
the offline recovery regressions and submitted browser fault/reconciliation
evidence. Only then integrate `427420eb` plus its corrections and rerun combined
acceptance against the new exact HEAD. Session 2 still owns the contrast and
permission-record handoff corrections; no design implementation is accepted yet.
No shared-contract change, deployment, live-service restart or paid API use.
